title: California tenant screening fee cap and refund duties
requirement: A landlord may not charge a screening fee above the annual cap ($68.96 for 2026) and must give the applicant a receipt, an itemized expense list, a copy of any credit report within 7 days, and a refund of any unused portion.
coverage_conditions: Residential rental applicants; a screening fee is charged when a rental unit is actually available.

applicability.per_tenancy: A screening fee may be charged when a rental unit is actually available; an unselected applicant must be refunded, or applications are reviewed in the order received and the first qualified applicant gets the unit.

quoted_span:
The maximum tenant screening fee for 2026 is
$68.96
Landlords may use screening fees to obtain information about a prospective tenant like a consumer credit report.

title: California reusable tenant screening report requirement
requirement: A landlord must use a reusable tenant screening report an applicant provides, and must give the applicant a copy of any consumer credit report obtained with the screening fee within 7 days of receiving it.
coverage_conditions: Residential rental applicants who provide a reusable screening report or pay a screening fee.

applicability.per_tenancy: Applies when an applicant provides a reusable screening report, or when a screening fee is used to obtain a consumer credit report.

quoted_span: Prospective tenants should expect to receive a copy of their credit report within 7 days of receipt by the landlord, a receipt for the fee paid and an itemized list of any out-of-pocket expenses and time spent by the landlord on the screening, and a refund of any unused portion of the fee. If the tenant provides a reusable screening report, the landlord must use it.

title: Berkeley tenant screening and application fee rules
requirement: Before taking a screening fee, an owner must give the applicant a tenant screening fee rights statement and the state fee cap; an owner may not charge an existing tenant a non-refundable fee to renew a tenancy or to change a roommate.
coverage_conditions: All residential rental agreements in Berkeley; owners or agents who charge a fee to obtain a consumer credit report to process a rental application.

applicability.per_tenancy: Applies to all residential rental agreements regardless of contrary lease terms; the disclosure duty attaches when an owner charges a screening fee.

penalty: Any provision of an existing rental agreement or lease that violates the chapter is unenforceable.
quoted_span: An owner of residential rental property (or the owner’s agent) cannot charge a non-refundable fee to any existing tenant for the purpose of renewing a tenancy, in whole or in part, including any fee associated with the departure of a roommate or to request to add or replace a roommate in a pre-existing household.
